narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>One more than ninety nine thousand nine hundred ninety nine is ten thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Count the digits. Ten thousand has five digits, and so did the number we started with.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Adding one cannot make the number smaller, so that slip is struck out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 99,999 + 1 = 10,000; the five nines of 99,999 glow beside a 10,000 with only five digits; the slip is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>A number made of nines becomes a one followed by zeros when we add one.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Each time, the answer is the smallest number with one more digit.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. What is the smallest seven digit number?
